reading: The sketch lays out a magazine-style promo page in a 3-column, 2-row grid: a top black title band, a left box with a quote and sideways 'LOUD' label, a center blue tile with yellow shapes, a right box with a numbered track/content list, a bottom-left pull-quote box, a bottom-middle credits box with an overlapping red 'SOLD OUT SOON' circular badge, and a bottom-right price callout ('£4' / 'post free in the UK'). Typed notes give exact copy, colours and styling for every region, which were followed over the raw ink shapes.
